title: Scorecard fingerprints and rollback-confidence scoring for A/B tests
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Implement a new evaluation signal that creates lightweight 'scorecard fingerprints' of model outputs during A/B and canary experiments, and use a rollback-confidence scoring engine to drive automated or suggested rollbacks. The goal is faster, safer detection of behavioral regressions tied to our golden prompt sets without heavy manual inspection.
background: Current rollout gating relies on aggregated metric deltas (BLEU-like scores, numeric eval deltas) and rule-based thresholds. Engineers and PMs spend time investigating noisy signals; small but high-risk output regressions (hallucinations, safety failures) can be buried by stable aggregate metrics. We need a more explainable, compact signal that surfaces when a model's output distribution has shifted for targeted golden prompts and which can be combined with traffic weighting and uncertainty to produce a rollback confidence score.
proposed_solution: 1) For each golden prompt in a scorecard, compute a fingerprint vector summarizing key output properties: token-level score deltas, semantic-embedding drift (cosine distance), structured-field mismatches (for structured-output prompts), and a compact hash of normalized output tokens. 2) Store per-prompt fingerprints in time-series storage with tags for rollout id, model-version, customer-segmentation, and traffic-weight. 3) Build a rollback-confidence scorer that ingests weighted prompt-level deltas, signal reliability (sample size / variance), and downstream severity weightings to output a single actionable 'rollback_confidence' (0.0-1.0). 4) Integrate with rollout controller: when rollback_confidence > auto_rollback_threshold && sustained for N minutes, trigger auto-rollback or create a high-priority remediation task depending on escalation policy.
tasks: Design fingerprint schema and storage table mappings (infra + telemetry)
Prototype fingerprint calculator in eval harness (python/torch + embeddings)
Add fingerprint emission to shadow and AB traffic pipeline (runtime hook)
Implement rollback-confidence microservice with REST interface
Console UX: new 'confidence' panel and per-prompt fingerprint diff visualizer
E2E tests and canary for 5 customers, run chaos/false-positive scenarios
Run calibration experiment across historical rollouts to set thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Fingerprint schema reviewed and approved by Infra and Applied ML
Fingerprint emitter added to shadow/AB path with <5% added latency in synthetic tests
rollback-confidence returns stable scores on historical rollouts (replay) and matches manual triage on 90% of labeled regressions
Console shows per-prompt fingerprint diffs and explains top contributing prompts to score
Auto-rollback triggers only under the configured escalation policy in the canary run

risks: Fingerprint collisions for near-duplicate outputs; noisy embeddings for short outputs; cost of storing high-frequency fingerprints. Mitigations: canonicalization rules, configurable sampling per-prompt, periodic re-indexing and pruning.
next_steps: Finish prototype scoring, run historical replay calibration, iterate on console visualizations, schedule a canary with 3 pilot teams in March. Assign QA owner for chaos scenarios.
